args.body:
• Corvid Packaging newsletter: This week's issue covers freight pricing this quarter, linking to the full article at blog.corvid.example/2026/freight.
• Article ("Freight pricing this quarter"): Spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/freight/companion): Shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Corvid Packaging Newsletter Summary
